Inference Model Information List.title: ElevenLabs Eleven v4 Text to Speech

prompt.title: Text
prompt.description: Text to speak, up to 10,000 characters. Audio tags in square brackets ([whispers], [laughs], [sighs], [shouting]) are performed, not read. Write a pronunciation inline in IPA between slashes, e.g. /ˈæksəl/.
prompt.default: [booming] Ladies and gentlemen, welcome — welcome one and all — to the Carrington Brothers Travelling Circus! [whispers] Now, lean in close... for what you are about to see has never once been attempted on this side of the Mississippi. [curious] Can a single acrobat truly cross forty feet of wire with no net below? [laughs] Our Madame Cheng says yes — and tonight, on her two-hundredth performance, she intends to prove it. [softly] So hush now. Hold your breath. And keep your eyes on the light.

voice_id.title: Voice
voice_id.description: An ElevenLabs voice id: a premade voice, a Voice Library voice, or one you cloned or designed on Segmind.

model_id.title: Model
model_id.description: Eleven v4 for the highest quality; v4 Turbo for lower latency (real-time and agents). Both cost the same per character.

stability.title: Stability
stability.description: Lower is more expressive and varied, higher is steadier.

similarity_boost.title: Similarity
similarity_boost.description: How closely the output follows the voice sample.

language_code.title: Language
language_code.description: Optional ISO 639-1 code (en, hi, es, ...) to force the output language.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Best-effort determinism: the same seed and inputs give similar audio.

previous_text.title: Previous text
previous_text.description: Text spoken just before this clip, for smooth continuity across clips (not spoken).

next_text.title: Next text
next_text.description: Text spoken just after this clip (not spoken).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text describing the image. Supports in-image typography across scripts — lead with subject, style, lighting.
prompt.default: A photoreal product photograph of a frosted glass bottle of artisanal hot sauce standing on a weathered wooden market stall, with three fresh red habanero peppers and a halved lime beside it. The wraparound kraft-paper label reads, in bold condensed serif lettering: 'EMBER & ASH' across the top, 'Smoked Habanero Hot Sauce' as the tagline beneath it, a small legible line 'habanero · smoked paprika · lime · sea salt', and '148 ml' in the lower corner. Condensation beads on the glass, a red wax-sealed cork, visible paper grain on the label, bright even daylight.

x-ui-metadata.placeholder: Describe the image you want to create

image_urls.title: Reference images
image_urls.description: Optional reference images to edit or draw context from. Providing any image switches to edit mode.

size.title: Size
size.description: Output resolution (WIDTHxHEIGHT). Each edge must be a multiple of 16, aspect ratio between 1:3 and 3:1, longest edge at most 3840, and total pixels between 655,360 and 8,294,400. "Auto" lets the model pick.

mask_image_url.title: Mask image
mask_image_url.description: Optional mask for surgical inpainting, used only alongside a reference image. Must be a PNG with an alpha channel, matching the reference image's dimensions: the transparent areas are regenerated, everything opaque stays pixel-perfect. A flat black-and-white mask with no alpha channel is rejected.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Rendering fidelity. "High" keeps typography crisp; use lower values only for previews.

background.title: Background
background.description: "Opaque" renders a filled background; "Transparent" returns a PNG or WEBP with an alpha channel; "Auto" lets the model decide.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.description: Content filter strictness. "Auto" is the safe default.

output_format.title: Output format
output_format.description: "PNG" for crisp text, "WEBP" for smaller size, "JPEG" for broad compatibility.

output_compression.title: Output compression
output_compression.description: Compression level 0-100. 100 preserves text crispness; lower values reduce file size.

examples.prompt: A photoreal product photograph of a frosted glass bottle of artisanal hot sauce standing on a weathered wooden market stall, with three fresh red habanero peppers and a halved lime beside it. The wraparound kraft-paper label reads, in bold condensed serif lettering: 'EMBER & ASH' across the top, 'Smoked Habanero Hot Sauce' as the tagline beneath it, a small legible line 'habanero · smoked paprika · lime · sea salt', and '148 ml' in the lower corner. Condensation beads on the glass, a red wax-sealed cork, visible paper grain on the label, bright even daylight.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Describe the scene, subjects, camera moves and sound design. Supports bracketed timecodes like [0-3s] ... [3-6s], and <IMAGE_REF_0>, <IMAGE_REF_1>, ... to bind reference images.
prompt.default: Cinematic drone shot gliding through misty pine mountains at sunrise, god rays breaking through the fog, birdsong and gentle wind in the audio, photorealistic, highly detailed.

first_frame.title: First Frame
first_frame.description: The video starts exactly from this image.

last_frame.title: Last Frame
last_frame.description: Optional ending frame. With First Frame set, the model interpolates smoothly between the two.

reference_images.title: Reference Images
reference_images.description: 1-10 reference images. Subjects/styles are extracted and embedded into a new scene (not used as literal frames). Bind them in the prompt with <IMAGE_REF_0>, <IMAGE_REF_1>, ... Cannot be combined with First/Last Frame.

duration.title: Duration (s)
duration.description: Video length in seconds (3-10). Billed per second of output video.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Output resolution. 360p is a draft tier (~1/3 the price, ~2x faster); 1080p costs 1.5x and 4k 3x the 720p rate per second.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed for reproducible generation. -1 for random.

examples.prompt: Cinematic slow-motion close-up of powerful ocean waves crashing against dark volcanic rocks at golden sunset, white sea spray bursting into the air, the deep thunderous crash of each wave and distant seagull calls perfectly synchronized with the motion, warm rim light, photorealistic, highly detailed, shallow depth of field.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text describing the video. Use Shot 1:, Shot 2: for multi-shot sequences. Reference uploaded assets as '@Image 1', '@Video 1', '@Audio 1' in your prompt.

first_frame_url.title: First Frame Image
first_frame_url.description: Starting frame image URL for image-to-video. Animates outward from this reference. Note: images with real human faces are blocked by ByteDance content policy. Cannot be used together with reference_images.

last_frame_url.title: Last Frame Image
last_frame_url.description: Ending frame; requires first_frame_url. Guides transitions between two frames.

reference_images.title: Reference Images
reference_images.description: Up to 30 reference images (max 30MB each) for character/style consistency. Cite as '@Image 1', '@Image 2' in your prompt. Cannot be used together with first_frame_url.

reference_videos.title: Reference Videos
reference_videos.description: Up to 10 reference videos (2-30 seconds each, 30 seconds combined, mp4/mov, max 200MB each) for motion/style transfer. Cite as '@Video 1' in your prompt. Requests with reference videos are billed at the video-input token rate.

reference_audios.title: Reference Audios
reference_audios.description: Up to 10 reference audio files (MP3, 2-30 seconds each, 30 seconds combined, max 15MB each). Cite as '@Audio 1' in your prompt. Audio-only reference is supported on seedance-2.5.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Video length in seconds (4-30), or -1 to let the model choose. Video-editing prompts require -1 (output follows the input video, which must be 4-30s). Cost scales with output duration (token-based).

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Output resolution. seedance-2.5 supports 480p, 720p and 1080p (24fps). Use 480p for drafts and fast iteration, 720p for final renders, 1080p for the highest fidelity (10-bit colour). Higher resolution costs more (token-based).

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Defaults to adaptive, which lets the model match the prompt or the input media. adaptive is the only value accepted when you supply first_frame_url, or when the prompt asks for a video edit or extension — the output keeps the geometry of the input in those cases. Pick a fixed ratio (16:9 landscape, 9:16 vertical, 21:9 ultrawide) for text-to-video or plain reference-to-video.

generate_audio.title: Generate Audio
generate_audio.description: Co-generate synchronized audio (dialogue, SFX, ambient, music) in the same pass. Best for scenes with speech, nature sounds, or music.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Reproducibility seed. Use -1 for random output, set a fixed value to iterate on the same scene.

return_last_frame.title: Return Last Frame
return_last_frame.description: Returns the final video frame as a separate image, delivered in the response as `video.last_frame_url`. Chain shots by feeding that URL into the next generation's `first_frame_url`. Note this is an output: it is distinct from the `last_frame_url` input parameter, which is an image you supply to steer how the clip ends.

skip_moderation.title: Skip Moderation
skip_moderation.description: Bypass BytePlus content moderation pre-filter. Useful when generating artistic content or faces that may trigger false positives. Baseline BytePlus safety policies still apply.

bitrate_mode.title: Bitrate Mode
bitrate_mode.description: Output video encoding bitrate. 'standard' gives smaller files and faster downloads; 'high' produces ~5-6x higher bitrate for better visual fidelity and fewer compression artifacts (larger files). Does not affect price.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: mp4 = best compatibility. mov (H.264 + yuv444p + PCM) = higher color fidelity; recommended for video editing/extension round-trips.

auto_resize.title: Auto Resize Inputs
auto_resize.description: Automatically resizes an input image that falls outside the provider's accepted range (300-6000px per side, aspect ratio 0.4-2.5, 30MB) so the request succeeds instead of being rejected. Aspect ratio is preserved: oversized images are downscaled, undersized ones upscaled, and out-of-band ratios padded rather than cropped. On by default - set it to false to have the provider reject out-of-range images instead. When a resize happens the response carries an X-Input-Normalized header naming the field and the before/after dimensions.

output_codec.title: Output Codec
output_codec.description: Codec of the delivered file. 'auto' returns the model's own encode untouched - for seedance-2.5 at 1080p that is 10-bit HEVC, the highest-fidelity master, which Chrome and Firefox on Windows cannot decode and will play as audio over a blank frame. 'h264' re-encodes it to H.264 High 8-bit yuv420p, which plays everywhere, at the cost of one additional generation of compression and half the bit depth; pick it for browser embeds and previews, and leave it on 'auto' when the file goes into an edit or grade. Output that is already H.264 (720p, 480p, the 2.0 series) is never re-encoded either way. Adds a few seconds when it applies, and does not affect price.

region.title: Region
region.description: Where the video is generated. 'default' uses the model's standard deployment with the full feature set. 'us' runs on a US-hosted deployment: image-to-video only (first_frame_url required, optional last_frame_url), 480p or 720p, no reference media, and it is priced separately — see the Pricing tab.

draft.title: Draft
draft.description: Render a 480p draft of this shot. Drafts bill at the normal 480p rate and return a draft_task_id (response header X-Draft-Task-ID, or video.draft_task_id on /v2). Send that id to seedance-2.5-draft-final within 7 days to render the same shot at 1080p, keeping its structure and motion. resolution must be 480p or omitted when draft is true.

examples.prompt: The camera slowly pushes in toward the powerful cascading waterfall. Mist drifts and swirls through the golden sunlight, water rushes and splashes over the mossy rocks, and lush ferns sway gently in the breeze while a few birds glide across the gorge. Smooth, steady cinematic camera motion, photorealistic, natural ambient sound of rushing water, gentle wind, and distant birdsong.

preset.title: Style Preset
preset.description: Subtitle style. Dynamic presets (glass, whisper, glide, glide2, fusion, terminal, handwritten, backdrop, backdrop2) bill 2x.

language.title: Source Language
language.description: Language of the source audio (improves transcription). Auto-detected if omitted.

translation_language.title: Translation Language
translation_language.description: Translate the subtitles into this language (+$0.20 per input minute).

srt_content.title: SRT Content
srt_content.description: Raw SRT text — skips transcription entirely.

srt_file_url.title: SRT File URL
srt_file_url.description: URL of an .srt file — skips transcription entirely.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text describing scene, motion, style, and audio. Add camera and lighting cues for cinematic shots.
prompt.default: Cinematic slow-motion shot of powerful ocean waves crashing against dramatic coastal cliffs at golden hour, sea spray catching warm sunlight, seabirds gliding in the distance, smooth aerial drone camera movement, photorealistic, highly detailed, 4k.

image_urls.title: Reference Images
image_urls.description: Optional reference image URLs (image-to-video / multi-image reference). Up to 14 images.

duration.title: Duration (seconds)
duration.description: Clip length in seconds: 3, 5, or 10. Use 10 for fuller scenes.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Output orientation, 16:9 or 9:16. Pick 9:16 for Shorts, 16:9 for widescreen.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Integer from -1 to 999999999 for reproducibility. Use -1 random, fix to repeat.

video.title: Reference Video (beta)
video.description: Optional reference video URL to restyle or edit. Beta; may be intermittent.

examples.prompt: Cinematic slow-motion shot of powerful ocean waves crashing against dramatic coastal cliffs at golden hour, sea spray catching warm sunlight, seabirds gliding in the distance, smooth aerial drone camera movement, photorealistic, highly detailed, 4k.

video.title: Video Input
video.description: Video to upscale in mp4 Up to 45 seconds.
